description: Checks whether HH^2(R[S_3]) could source Term 2's Φ_q Cauchy kernel via q-deformation of the group algebra. Finds HH^1 = 0 directly; HH^2 = 0 by Burghelea + Maschke (finite group over char-0 field, no cohomology in positive degrees).  Concludes deformation cohomology does NOT give Term 2 either.  The Cauchy kernel's natural source is quantum-group / brane-geometric.
conclusion: Neither HH^* of H_3(q) nor HH^* of R[S_3] sources Term 2's Φ_q Cauchy kernel.  Route CLOSED.
